result.summary: The page is largely intact; the carousel edge-clipping and the card cut off at the bottom are intentional scroll behavior. Two minor defects stand out: a misspelling in the search placeholder and a stray divider line in the bottom tab bar.

issues.description: The search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restaurants' is misspelled, missing the 'u'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: A thin vertical gray line appears inside the bottom tab bar between the Search and Orders icons, looking like an unintended divider or rendering artifact rather than part of the navigation design.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray vertical stroke so the tab bar background is uniform between the icons.
